title: Puttering Pleatfin
statement: A palm-sized cuttlefish with accordion-frilled fins and ink-blue freckles, the Puttering Pleatfin patiently props sea-glass rings upright in the sand, then squeezes through doorways considerably smaller than its head. Its tank is a quiet grotto of midnight-blue stone and honey-colored light, with a broad white sand bed where every tidy arrangement eventually becomes an obstacle course.
